text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both Mejiro Palmer and Ines Fujin lost 
their steam, suffering defeat in the 
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though both collapsed in exhaustion, they 
praised each other's fighting spirit. A 
faint friendship had begun to sprout.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night, Daitaku Helios looked back on 
today's race and seemed to have come up 
with some kind of god-tier race plan.
